rates.title: Hourly rates — {{name}}
rates.intro: A rate applies from the date you choose — to every entry from that day on, including ones already logged. Entries before it stay as they are, and so do individually priced ones.

empty.title: No hourly rate yet
empty.message: Set which rate applies from which date. Later changes — for example a contract extension — can be scheduled here in advance.

rate.label: New hourly rate
rate.min: Hourly rate must be zero or higher

validFrom.label: Valid from
validFrom.helper: A future date schedules the change.
validFrom.requiredOnChange: Please choose from when the new rate applies.

messages.conflict: A rate already starts on that date. Edit that period instead, or pick another start date.
messages.deleteConfirm: Really delete the rate from {{date}}? Time already logged keeps its rate.

messages.repriced_other: {{count}} already logged entries were moved to {{rate}}.

impact.scheduled: Takes effect automatically on {{date}}. Until then {{previous}} still applies.
impact.endsAt: From {{date}} the next rate that is already agreed applies.
impact.replaces: A rate of {{rate}} already starts on {{date}} — this one replaces it.
impact.invoicesSince_one: {{count}} invoice has already been issued to this client since {{date}}. Check whether these entries were billed in it before moving them.
impact.invoicesSince_other: {{count}} invoices have already been issued to this client since {{date}}. Check whether these entries were billed in them before moving them.
impact.noLogged: Nothing has been logged in this period yet — no existing time is affected.

impact.deviating_other: {{count}} individually priced entries stay as they are.
impact.keepExisting: Keep the current rate for entries already logged (e.g. because they are already invoiced)
